core_obligations: Statement (lines 1309-1312): if Gamma proves A and x is free in no formula of Gamma, then Gamma proves forall x A.

Induction on the theorem relation (proof lines 1314-1323): if A is an axiom so is forall x A; if A is in Gamma then x is not free in A, so A -> forall x A is an Ax3 instance and MP closes; if A follows by MP from B and B -> A, the induction hypothesis gives the universal closures and the Ax2 distribution instance plus two MP applications close.
proof_roadmap: Axiom case: universal closures of axioms are axioms.
Member case: Ax3 instance plus MP.
MP case: induction hypothesis plus the Ax2 distribution instance.
difficulty_reason: Generalization theorem (statement 1309-1312, proof 1314-1323): three-case induction on the derivability relation, each case closing through a named axiom scheme. H2.
